title: Bose
desc: When the man who hired him turns out to be a criminal, Bose loses his temper and shoots him. However, this action bears heavy consequences on his personal life.

title: Maasi
desc: Maasi, a police officer, gets caught in the middle of a rivalry between mobsters and loses his partner and mother in the course. Later, he embarks on a revenge quest.

title: Maruthu Pandi
desc: Maruthu, a boat operator, lives an ordinary life with his sister. He falls in love with a woman but soon finds out a shocking secret about her identity.

title: Agni Natchathiram
desc: Vishwanath has two sons, Gautam and Ashok, who are step-brothers and hate each other. But the two of them join hands in order to protect their father from a mafia.

title: Nimirnthu Nil
desc: Aravindan, a young orphan man, gathers a team along with his girlfriend to fight a corrupt system. However, things become complicated when he starts investigating people who wield power.
